chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 297: The King Ship Sets Sail – Half-Ancestors Depart for the Mortal World
chapter_meta_description: Half-ancestors lead an exodus from the World of Immortality. Xiao Chen retrieves the Little Defiant Dragon, the headless monk Shenxiu appears, and Dragon Island's divine stele comes under attack.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch. 297 – The King Ship Departs
og_description: The exodus begins as half-ancestors board the Ancestral Dragon Ship and King Ship. Xiao Chen reunites with old allies, and a crisis unfolds at Dragon Island.
twitter_title: World of Immortality #297 – Exodus from the Eternal Continent
twitter_description: Half-ancestors prepare to leave the World of Immortality. Xiao Chen retrieves the Little Defiant Dragon, and Shenxiu's headless corpse appears on the Forbidden Sea.
